chunks: Muḥammad ibn Sahl narrated from his father, who said:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man whose ploughman cultivates saffron for him and guarantees for him that he will give him such-and-such dirhams for each measured jarīb of land. Sometimes it decreases and he incurs loss, and sometimes it increases.
He عليه السلام said: “There is no harm in it if the two mutually agree.”

key_terms.الْحَرَّاثُ: the farmer or ploughman who cultivates the land
key_terms.تَرَاضَيَا: the two parties mutually agreed and were satisfied
key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: a dirham amount specified as payment

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islamic law to agree on a fixed payment for cultivated land even if the yield may vary?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses a contractual farming arrangement involving saffron cultivation and a fixed payment per measured unit of land. Imām Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام rules that such an arrangement is permissible when both parties are mutually satisfied with the agreement.
